name: Wittiza
role: Visigoth King of Hispania from 694 to c.710
contribution: The king of the Visigoths from 694 until his death, co-ruling with his father, Egica, until 702 or 703.

checks.lead: Wittiza (Witiza, Witica, Witicha, Vitiza, or Witiges; c. 687 – probably 710) was the king of the Visigoths from 694 until his death, co-ruling with his father, Egica, until 702 or 703.
